question: In October 2022, Harmanpreet Singh, who was honoured with the Player of the Year award is related to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hockey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh** is related to **hockey** and was honoured with the **Player of the Year award **in **October 2022.**
 
• He is an **Indian professional field hockey player** who plays as a defender for the Indian national team.
 
• Harmanpreet Singh has represented India in several international tournaments including the** Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.**
 
• He was also a part of the Indian team that won the **FIH Junior World Cup** in **2016.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey** is a popular sport in India and the Indian men's hockey team has won** 8 Olympic gold medals**, the most recent being in** Tokyo 2020.**

 
 
• Known as one of the best field hockey players of all time, **Dhyan Chand** was an Indian athlete.
 
 
 
• **Badminton** is another popular sport in India and has produced many world-class players such as **Saina Nehwal, PV Sindhu,** and** Kidambi Srikanth.**
 
• **Cricket** is the most popular sport in India and the Indian cricket team is one of the top teams in the world.
 
 
• The team has won **2 ODI World Cups** and **1 T20 World Cup.**
 
 
 
• **Football **is also gaining popularity in India, with the **Indian Super League** being a major professional league in the country.
 
 
• However, the Indian national football team is** not **ranked highly in the FIFA rankings.
